scope: 22 original topics checked against official agendas and abstracts on 2026-10-08. Five official PDF decks read on 2026-10-09, including CRIU/RDMA. On 2026-10-17, added an IPADS follow-up lecture by LPC speaker Yusheng Zheng and the LPC eBPF topic as provenance (24 LPC topics referenced; original 22-topic map unchanged). The IPADS lecture is separate related material, not an LPC attachment. Current PDF has 21 pages; presentation date is 2026-10-16, upload time not established. AgentSight and ActPlane results were checked against versioned papers. Older per-source check dates remain unchanged; video recordings not reviewed.

sources.basis: author paper v2, section 5.6 and Figure 15
sources.verification_notes: 361 tasks in OpenHands Docker runtime. This denominator is not all 361 tasks.
